properties.attribution: Albert Herrmann and Georg Westermann, Historical and Commercial Atlas of China (1935), map 38; adapted by World History Atlas

note.en: Approximate 1415 outline traced from a 1935 historical atlas, shown as a fixed reference through 1417, not an annual reconstruction. It includes the Ming occupation of northern Đại Việt; resistance and local control varied. The older map combines core administration and frontier claims, and its far-northeastern area is cut off by the map inset.
note.zh: 依据1935年历史地图集提取的1415年概略轮廓，作为固定年代参照显示至1417年，并非逐年复原。图中包括明朝对大越北部的占领；抵抗与地方控制程度并不相同。旧地图混合了核心行政区与边疆主张，其东北远部被图中插图遮断。

sources.title: Map of Ming Chinese empire 1415, Historical and Commercial Atlas of China, map 38

sources.evidenceNote: Commons classifies this 1935 source as public domain in the US through non-renewal and as PD-old-70; territorial limits and the scanned inset remain visible limitations.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 维基共享资源将该1935年地图标为美国未续展的公共领域作品及作者逝世70年以上作品；地区版权差异和原图插图遮断范围仍须注意。

sources.title: Vietnam — Timeline of Historical Periods
sources.evidenceNote: Lists Ming occupation of Đại Việt in 1407–1427 and resistance beginning in 1418; it does not establish individual map vertices.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 列出1407–1427年明朝占领大越及1418年开始的抵抗；不验证地图边界顶点。

sources.title: Ming Dynasty (1368–1644)
sources.evidenceNote: Provides the overall Ming chronology, not a survey of this boundary.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 提供明朝总体年代，并非该边界的测绘。
